text:
**My pick: the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. It lists at $109 but was $98 at WIRED, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. It has a 2-year warranty. Prices can change, so check at checkout.

I can't browse, so the links below go to the review pages I pulled these from. The shop buttons for each product are in those articles.

**Other good options**
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It gives 25W to your iPhone and has a heavy, premium base. The power adapter isn't included, and you need a 40W one. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, about $40 on sale (list $80).** It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. It charges at 15W and includes the power brick and cable, but its warranty is only 1 year. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Sleeping flat: Nimble Podium, $130.** The phone and watch lie flat, and the pads can pop up for StandBy. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80 on sale.** It folds slim and charges at 15W. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99.** It's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested, and it includes a 45W adapter. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **25W with a cooling fan: ESR CryoBoost, $99.99.** The fan can be switched off for sleeping. ESR's code PARTNER18 takes it to about $82 through [this ESR link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand), which is an affiliate link. [Dealectric's page](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) says the code expires 2026-12-31. WIRED covers it in its [travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) at $100.

**Things to know**
- **25W only helps some iPhones.** ESR says full 25W applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- **Speed matters less overnight.** WIRED says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin is enough for most people.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging for the third spot to work.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether this is for a nightstand, desk or travel, I can narrow it to one.
